title: Extra per-iteration overhead from computing targets in representation space
description: I-JEPA introduces extra overhead (about 7% slower per iteration) by computing targets in representation space rather than using raw pixels directly. This is partially offset by faster convergence but remains a computational cost.
canonical_description: extra overhead from computing prediction targets in representation space

evidence.quote: Compared to reconstruction-based methods, such as MAE, which directly use pixels as targets, \putalg introduces extra overhead by computing targets in representation space (about 7\% slower time per iteration).
